title: Afterparty
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Confiscate the remaining Dance Lessons from monsters in the Lower Off Dungeons of Balzack's Burrow. Bring the left-over Dance Lessons back to the Townston Commander in Townston.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Balzack's Burrow

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Confiscate the remaining Dance Lessons from monsters in the Lower Off Dungeons of Balzack's Burrow. Bring the left-over Dance Lessons back to the Townston Commander in Townston.

Offer:

Pretty good work there, Dungeon Runner. Messy work, but good. It seems that while you were gone, the Oroks made more copies of the Dance Lessons. Why? I'm not really sure, but we can't risk them somehow finding a way to dance from them.

I need you to head down into Balzack's Burrow again and confiscate the Dance Lessons you can find. When you finish, bring them back up to me, the Townston Commander. Maybe then I can learn how to dance...you know, so I can better understand their motives. It's reseach...for work! What?!

Turn-in:

Twenty-eight, twenty-nine, thirty. I think you dropped some back there. Mind going to get some more?

Objectives:

  • Confiscated Dance Lessons ×30

Client level range: 65–100
